name: Living Concourse
notes: Station concourse uses a true 2:1 isometric camera: raised deck sides, spoke corridors with volume, and a lit hub disc instead of a flat floor plan.
Crew, kiosks, shuttle, and furniture share that camera and depth-sort with the hull. Stick and WASD walk in screen space so down on the stick still moves down the view.
Planet sites stay overhead. Hull collision and desks are unchanged. Rollback: git checkout v2.12.1 for the bird’s-eye station.
